newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sarrio first half profit rises 11.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sarrio first half profit rises 11.3 pct.

text.p: Italian-controlled cardboard carton manufacturer Sarrio SA, which returned to profit in 1995, said net first half profit was 993 million pesetas in 1996, up 11.3 percent from the same period last year.

"The improvement in profit is due mainly to good results in the cardboard packaging sector, in which the group operates -- as opposed to the paper sector which has seen weaker growth -- and to lower financial coasts," the company said in a statement.
Sarrio had net profit of 957 million pesetas in 1995 after a loss of 4.28 billion the year before.
Sarrio traded up 10 pesetas at 443 at 1550 GMT with 141,404 shares traded.
